cases.question: What was total net revenue in 2025?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Net revenue by channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

cases.question: What was net revenue by region last quarter?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS f
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON f.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE f.order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND f.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

cases.question: Show monthly net revenue in 2026, oldest month first
cases.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: What was net revenue in Q3 2025 and in Q3 2026? Give one row per year.
cases.sql:
SELECT
    YEAR(order_date) AS year,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE (order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-10-01')
   OR (order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01')
GROUP BY YEAR(order_date)
ORDER BY year

cases.question: What was gross revenue in December 2025?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue), 2) AS gross_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Gross margin percentage by product category in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(SUM(s.gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC

cases.question: Top 3 brands by gross margin dollars in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.brand,
    ROUND(SUM(s.gross_margin), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 3

cases.question: What was the discount rate in November and December 2025 combined?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS discount_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many orders were placed in September 2026?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Average order value by channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel

cases.question: Compare return rate by channel across all time
cases.sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_returned THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel

cases.question: How many units were sold in 2025, excluding returns?
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(quantity) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_returned) AS units_sold
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: What percentage of 2026 orders were buy online pick up in store?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'bopis') * 100.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0),
    2
) AS bopis_order_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

cases.question: How many customers are in each segment?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers
FROM analytics.dim_customer
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment

cases.question: Average order value by loyalty tier in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.loyalty_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier
ORDER BY c.loyalty_tier

cases.question: How many active customers bought something in Q3 2026?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most net revenue overall?
cases.sql:
SELECT c.state, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.state
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many customers placed more than 10 orders in total?
cases.sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM analytics.fct_sales
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 10
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_orders

cases.question: How many customers signed up in 2025?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_signed_up
FROM analytics.dim_customer
WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Top 5 stores by net revenue in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS f
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON f.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE f.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND f.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many stores are there of each format?
cases.sql:
SELECT store_format, COUNT(*) AS store_count
FROM analytics.dim_store
GROUP BY store_format
ORDER BY store_format

cases.question: Average net revenue per store in each region for 2025
cases.sql:
WITH store_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        s.region,
        SUM(f.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
    FROM analytics.dim_store AS s
    LEFT JOIN analytics.fct_sales AS f
        ON f.store_id = s.store_id
        AND f.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
        AND f.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    WHERE s.opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.region
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(net_revenue), 2) AS average_net_revenue_per_store
FROM store_revenue
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

cases.question: How many units are on hand right now?
cases.sql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) AS snapshot_month
    FROM analytics.fct_inventory
)
SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_units) AS units_on_hand
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN latest_snapshot AS l
    ON i.snapshot_month = l.snapshot_month

cases.question: How many store and product combinations are below their reorder point in the latest snapshot?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_product_combinations_below_reorder_point
FROM analytics.fct_inventory
WHERE snapshot_month = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_month)
    FROM analytics.fct_inventory
)
AND on_hand_units < reorder_point

cases.question: Units on hand by product category in June 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(i.on_hand_units) AS units_on_hand
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.snapshot_month = DATE '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: What is the value at cost of current inventory by region?
cases.sql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) AS snapshot_month
    FROM analytics.fct_inventory
)
SELECT
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_units * p.unit_cost), 2) AS inventory_value_at_cost
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN latest_snapshot AS ls
    ON i.snapshot_month = ls.snapshot_month
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

cases.question: Return on ad spend by marketing channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    marketing_channel,
    SUM(attributed_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0) AS roas
FROM analytics.fct_marketing
WHERE week_start >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND week_start < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY marketing_channel
ORDER BY roas DESC

cases.question: Total marketing spend in Q4 2025
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS marketing_spend
FROM analytics.fct_marketing
WHERE week_start >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND week_start < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Which week and channel had the single highest marketing spend?
cases.sql:
SELECT week_start, marketing_channel
FROM analytics.fct_marketing
ORDER BY spend DESC
LIMIT 1
